Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relationship)
Topic 6.3: Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety
2. Practise Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety in the examples.
2. Explain Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety
2. Practise Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Contemporary issues • Rights of Women in Islam • HIV and AIDS • COVID-19 • Child Road Safety
